The animal's head is lowered, obscuring the nose and mouth, but the broad, blunt shape of the head and small rounded ears are visible. The fur appears coarse, thick, and greyish-brown. The body is stocky and barrel-shaped, consistent with the species' robust build. Only the upper torso and head are clearly visible; limbs are largely obscured by the angle and vegetation.
